# Begapunk Precision Rotary Joint Manufacturer
# 气动旋转接头制造商 | Rotary Union Manufacturer

## Overview
Begapunk is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer of pneumatic rotary joints and rotary unions based in Ningbo, China. We specialize in single-channel and multi-channel rotary joints for industrial automation, CNC machining, laser cutting, packaging machinery, and steel smelting equipment. 200,000+ units delivered to 40+ countries.

## Core Products
- 1-in-1-out rotary joints (BP-1P series)
- 2-in-2-out rotary joints (BP-2P series)
- 3-in-3-out rotary joints (BP-3P series)
- 4-in-4-out rotary joints (BP-4P series)
- 8-in-8-out rotary joints (BP-8P series)
- Heavy-duty rotary joints (up to 10 MPa)
- Dust-proof rotary joints (IP65)
- Custom multi-channel designs

## Key Specifications
- Media: Compressed air, water, coolant, hydraulic oil
- Pressure: 0.1 - 10 MPa (standard: 1 MPa)
- Speed: 100 - 10,000 RPM (standard: 200-500 RPM)
- Materials: AL6061 aluminum, 45# steel, 304/316 stainless steel
- Seals: PTFE composite, carbon fiber, graphite, ceramic
- Connections: Threaded (NPT/BSP) or flange mount

## Certifications
- ISO 9001:2015
- CE Certified
- RoHS Compliant

## Services
- Free 3D STEP/IGES files
- Custom design (3-week delivery)
- 12-month replacement warranty
- DDP shipping to EU and North America
- 7-14 day standard delivery
